items.title: Mann fikk hjertestans på buss ved Oslo S
items.excerpt: Mange ble vitne til hendelsen. Nå deler helsevesenet en viktig beskjed.

items.title: Erkjenner utfordringene på Torshov og varsler ny boligmelding
items.excerpt: Vi har et ansvar for at mennesker som har utfordringer med rus og psykiatri får en kommunal bolig, samtidig jobber vi for å skape tryggere bomiljøer, skriver byråd for sosiale tjenester Julianne Ferskaug (V).

items.title: Tap for Selvik
items.excerpt: Egil Selvik, som kjemper med Ørjan Nyland om kampen som førstekeeper på landslaget, slapp inn to mål da Brest møtte Nice i den franske serien fredag kveld. Nice vant kampen 2–1. Ludovic Ajorque sendte Brest i ledelsen, før Elye Wah og Sofiane Diop overlistet Selvik i andre omgang. Brest er nummer elleve i Ligue 1 etter sju serierunder.

items.title: Nottingham stoppet tapsrekka
items.excerpt: Etter tre strake tap i serien, klarte Nottingham Forest å med seg et poeng hjem fra fredagens Premier League-kamp borte mot Ipswich. Nico Williams ga gjestene ledelsen etter 13 minutter. Utligningen kom etter 41 minutter da Julio Enciso utnyttet en enorm tabbe i Nottingham-forsvaret. items.title: Borussia M'gladbach finally get first win after five-goal thriller
items.excerpt: Bundesliga's bottom side Borussia Monchengladbach come from behind to beat Stuttgart 3-2, as the away side secure their first league win of the season, at the seventh attempt.

items.title: Villa could reconsider Garnacho deal - Saturday's gossip
items.excerpt: Aston Villa have doubts on making Alejandro Garnacho deal a permanent move, Brighton to stand firm on Diego Gomez amid interest, Manchester United managerial candidates concern over players, plus more.

items.title: Masked gunmen kill seven in attack on church funeral in Jordan
items.excerpt: At least seven people were killed and 34 wounded after two masked gunmen opened fire at a church in Karak, Jordan.

items.title: Impressive Gloucester beat rivals Bath in Prem
items.excerpt: Gloucester storm to their first win over Bath in the Prem at Kingsholm since April 2022 with a 23-5 victory built on an immense defensive display.

items.title: Wade equals Prem try-scoring record as Newcastle beat Sale
items.excerpt: Christian Wade equals Chris Ashton's Prem try-scoring record with a 101st score as Newcastle post their first league win of their season against Sale.

items.title: Ebola: Kenya announces second death
items.excerpt: Kenya has recorded a second Ebola death, ‌the ⁠Health ⁠Ministry said late Friday. ​The 65-year-old ​woman had developed ​symptoms ‌during quarantine and was a close ‌relative of a ‌Kenyan ​man who died of the disease.
